summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K on June 11, 2026, reporting a routine equity compensation grant to employees. The Board granted 15,894 restricted stock units (fair value DKK 1,616.50 each, vesting after three years) and 15,494 warrants (exercise price DKK 1,616.50, vesting after three years, expiring at seven years). This is an ordinary compensatory arrangement, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
